title: Foods that fight inflammation
summary: Harvard Health's guide to foods that calm inflammation (tomatoes, olive oil, leafy greens, nuts, fatty fish, fruit) and ones to limit (refined carbs, fried foods, sugary drinks, red and processed meat), with the Mediterranean diet as the easiest plan to follow.

title: Depression May Involve an Imbalance Between Two Important Brain Networks
summary: A Better Brain post on why depression can make it so hard to stop overthinking or concentrate, pointing to an imbalance between two important brain networks, along with other abnormalities.

title: We Completely Misunderstood Mental Health Diagnoses
summary: Science Illustrated on a huge DNA analysis showing the lines between autism, ADHD, anxiety and depression are much blurrier than we thought, which helps explain why so many people end up with several diagnoses.
